headline: Stlican Shelf Flares Anew as Callahan's Passage Bleeds On
war_summary: Since our last edition the fire has shifted east: Stlican Shelf, quiet in our last columns, has flared anew with five actions inside two hours, the freshest fighting on any front, and the Wardens have recovered a second post there, leaving seven of nine under Colonial colors. Neighbor Stonecradle echoes the flare with five actions in two hours, though losses run light. Callahan's Passage remains the costliest theater—some 900 Colonial and 680 Warden fallen in the past hour alone, seventeen actions in the day about Crumbling Post and The Crumbling Passage, yet all ten strongholds answer to the Wardens. The Weathered Expanse churns on: forty actions in the day, five inside two hours, Wightwalk and Crow's Nest again busiest; five posts stand Colonial and four lie demolished, none Warden. The Nevish Line has hushed inside two hours after fifty-six actions, its two Colonial footholds holding against six Warden. Palantine Berm cools with all seven posts Warden-held, while Mooring County, idle of base actions, bleeds afresh—270 Colonial and 228 Warden in two hours. It is day 494; thirty-four victory towns decide this war, and no victor is named.
